Internal: the variables jload()'s text = names

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_jload_text_cols.Rd

Ruling R31 (Session 380): text = names variables, so under ruling R18 it takes names bare or in quotes, or a c() of either, each read without evaluating it. A name is the file's own or the one jload() gives the variable ("Post code" or Post_code). A bare name the file does not have, but which holds names in the workspace, is read for them; any other expression is evaluated and must give names. A name the file has under neither form stops, every such name in one stop (voice Rule AJ), with the file's names listed, as sheet = lists the sheets.

Usage

.jst_jload_text_cols(sub, env, raw_nm, shown)

Arguments

sub

text = as typed (substitute(text)).

env

The caller's environment.

raw_nm

The names as the file has them.

shown

The file's name, for the stop.

Value

Integer vector: the variables' positions.
